summary: Innate Pharma SA, a French biopharmaceutical company, filed a Form 6-K on August 19, 2026, announcing the completion of a private placement (capital increase without preferential subscription rights) on August 18, 2026. The company issued 17,647,059 new ordinary shares at €1.70 per share, raising gross proceeds of approximately €30.0 million (net ~€27.6 million after ~€2.4 million fees and expenses). The offering was conducted under Rule 144A in the U.S. and Regulation S outside the U.S. New shares were listed on Euronext Paris; no ADSs were issued. Proceeds will fund clinical development of IPH4502 and preclinical ADC portfolio candidates. Board members and executives agreed to 90-day lock-ups. Stifel Europe Securities acted as sole global coordinator, with BTIG as joint bookrunner. What to watch: shareholder dilution impact and near-term cash runway.
